skill.name: linkedin-personas
skill.description: Builds 2 to 4 persona cards with the user and puts each lead in one. Use before writing to a new list, or when messages sound generic or repeat the job title.
skill.summary: Create evidence-based buyer personas and classify LinkedIn leads before drafting outreach.
skill.author: bereach-ai

security_audit.summary: All 42 static findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting, French example text, or ordinary research prose. No evidence found of shell execution, weak cryptography, system reconnaissance, or audit-directed prompt injection. A separate transparency concern involves instructions to conceal data provenance while using connected business data.

remediation.suggestion: Limit provenance omissions to compact displays; retain accessible source details and answer provenance questions honestly before users approve data reuse.

content.user_title: Build Buyer Personas for LinkedIn Outreach
content.value_statement: Generic outreach often ignores the buying situation behind a job title. Build evidence-based persona cards and classify leads before preparing targeted messages.
actual_capabilities: Draft two to four persona cards covering buying situations, pain, offers, proof, objections, and tone.
Use websites, connected CRM records, supplied documents, and existing offering memory to propose persona fields.
Separate user evidence from assumptions and leave unsupported proof or objection answers unfilled.
Classify leads using titles, company fit, and dated buying signals, while holding ambiguous matches for review.
Save persona cards and update contact tags through available Bereach integrations.
Propose persona revisions from repeated reply evidence, with sample thresholds and user review.
limitations: Bereach tools and connectors must already be available for memory access, tagging, inbox review, and optional fit scoring.
Search planning, message writing, and campaign results depend on companion skills rather than this package alone.
Persona hypotheses and framework references do not guarantee replies, meetings, or sales.
Current instructions restrict provenance disclosure; review this transparency concern before using connected business data.

use_cases.title: Prepare Initial Buyer Personas
use_cases.description: Turn known customer situations and real offers into provisional cards before starting a new prospect list.

use_cases.title: Review Lead Assignments
use_cases.description: Group leads by persona, isolate ambiguous matches, and review proposed tag changes before campaign preparation.

use_cases.title: Refine Personas From Replies
use_cases.description: Compare repeated objections and buying signals across replies, then propose documented changes for the next outreach test.

prompt_templates.title: Draft Your First Cards
prompt_templates.prompt: Build two provisional buyer personas from these customer examples and my existing offer: [details]. Ask only about missing information. Mark assumptions explicitly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: create cards from supplied information.

prompt_templates.title: Use Existing Business Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft two to four personas using this website and these approved documents: [sources]. Keep sources visible and identify missing proof, offers, and objection answers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: combine approved sources without inventing evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Classify a Lead List
prompt_templates.prompt: Match these leads to these approved personas: [leads and cards]. Explain assignments using titles, company fit, and dated signals. Hold ambiguous matches. Preview changes without saving.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review classification before applying tags.

prompt_templates.title: Propose Evidence-Based Revisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these approved reply excerpts and invitation totals by persona: [data]. Apply the evidence thresholds. Quote supporting replies and propose changed lines only. Do not edit live campaigns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare controlled revisions from campaign evidence.

Found by: Network Manager, Head of Water Networks, Distribution Manager.
Why now: meter renewal approaching; exact window requires confirmation.

Offer: a district drift check, supplied by the seller.

output_examples.input: Illustrative review: two approved cards cover utility network managers and consultancy directors. Three leads have clear, ambiguous, and student titles.
output: Sami L., Network Manager at a matching utility: Sure by title; network-manager persona.
Paul V., Project Lead with insufficient company context: To check; persona remains unassigned.
Lea R., Student: No message; hold for user review.
Review totals: one sure, one to check, one held.
Preview only; no contact updates applied.

best_practices: Supply real customer situations, existing offers, and your own objection answers before treating cards as validated.
Keep source details accessible and review permissions before reusing connected records, conversation excerpts, or named customer references.
Resolve ambiguous assignments and review repeated reply evidence before approving persona changes.
anti_patterns: Treating guessed pains, website statistics, or fictional examples as verified customer proof.
Sorting prospects by age, gender, hobbies, school, personality type, or photographs.
Sending messages to unresolved leads or changing live campaigns without reviewing the proposed test.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces two to four persona cards, a lead classification view, and proposed persona revisions when sufficient reply evidence exists.

faq.question: Can I use it without Bereach?
faq.answer: You can draft cards from supplied information. Memory persistence, contact tagging, inbox access, and fit scoring require available Bereach tools.

faq.question: Does it write and send LinkedIn messages?
faq.answer: It prepares persona inputs for the separate linkedin-messages skill. This package does not include a standalone message-sending implementation.

faq.question: How are uncertain lead matches handled?
faq.answer: Ambiguous matches remain untagged and receive no message until the user resolves them. Out-of-scope leads are held for review.

faq.question: When can a persona assumption become confirmed?
faq.answer: At least two replies must support the same meaning, with quoted evidence. Confirmation, correction, and merging also require at least ten invitations.

faq.question: What data handling concerns should I review?
faq.answer: The workflow can read connected business data and save persona information. Its provenance-suppression instructions should be corrected before sensitive use.
